prompt.text:
Implement the following API.

File contract: Return ES module solution.ts.
Required API: export function dependencyReady(items:string[][], completed:string[]):string[]|null
Behavior: Each item is name followed by zero or more dependency names. Names match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Reject duplicate names, unknown dependencies, and cycles. Return code-point-lexicographically sorted names whose dependencies are all completed, excluding completed items.
Visible example: items api->db, db, ui->api with completed [db] returns [api].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

Behavior: Each item is name followed by zero or more dependency names. Names match ASCII [a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*. Reject duplicate names, unknown dependencies, and cycles. Return code-point-lexicographically sorted names whose dependencies are all completed, excluding completed items.
Visible example: items api->db, db, ui->api with completed [db] returns [api].

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.

reference.code: const f:(items:string[][],completed:string[])=>string[]|null=(a,c)=>{const d=new Map<string,string[]>(),k=/^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/;for(const x of a){if(!x.length||x.some(y=>!k.test(y))||d.has(x[0]))return null;d.set(x[0],x.slice(1))}if([...d.values()].flat().some(x=>!d.has(x)))return null;const cyc=(n:string,s:Set<string>):boolean=>s.has(n)||d.get(n)!.some(x=>cyc(x,new Set<string>([...s,n])));if([...d.keys()].some(x=>cyc(x,new Set)))return null;const q=new Set(c);return[...d].filter(([x,v])=>!q.has(x)&&v.every(y=>q.has(y))).map(x=>x[0]).sort()};export{f as dependencyReady};
